description: An extension supplies constants, classifier entries, and implications to an earlier stage (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $w('a') <classify(text($w), lex) ∪ $K> %emits $
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X
%extend-stage first
%const $K Z
%classifier lex
  "a" ∈ A
%implies A ⟹ X
```
